witness.lemma_fragment: For every labeled simple graph G on vertex set {0,...,n-1} with n <= 6: if the least-common-neighbor edge coloring (color{u,v} = min{w : w adjacent to both u and v}, undefined if no such w) has a monochromatic triangle (three triangle edges sharing one defined color), then G contains a K4.

claim: PASS (main() == True) establishes the finite-instance fragment (n <= 6) of L1's core implication — a monochromatic triangle in the least-common-neighbor coloring forces a K4 — by exhaustive exact enumeration with zero tolerance; covers=fragment (the full lemma covers all n and the branch-B reduction, not decided by this finite check).
law: Wang 7.2: an exact finite object plus a proved reduction is a CERTIFICATE. The reduction is the `claim` and is a human's to audit; the object and the verifier run are the machine's part.
